mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate crosses above 7.5% from below, it signals labor market stress, leading to reduced consumer confidence and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate indicate conflicting policy signals, creating market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, sustained upward pressure on the unemployment rate above 6% suggests labor market normalization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months during post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO <100) combined with rising federal funds rates signals tightening monetary policy and weakening demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Continuously increasing housing starts (HOUST) indicate expanding demand for housing, boosting corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation index exceeds 233.808, signaling accelerating price pressures, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a contraction phase, a sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO <100) reflects weakening supply chains, prompting investors to buy undervalued assets and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
